Its exact uncommitted bytes remain in the shared checkout and are frozen by the 2026-08-31T17:51Z chief blocker note on epic bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ. Do not delete or overwrite that shared evidence.

Author: codex-storymodel4s-collab, after completing the short immutable review already in its inbox. Work in a standalone clone rooted at e584ad6; import the frozen output slice and repair there. Never commit on shared main.

Exact allowed paths:
- build.sbt
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/cache.scala
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/output.scala
- acquire/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/OutputSuite.scala

- view/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/view/output.scala

- codec/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/codec/output_acquire.scala

The accepted spec docs/design/story-output-bundle-spec.md at SHA-256 53ab5245917351268b45d2b6765ddf6f67324131bfc1bdf8da184edbabba9b7f is read-only input, not an editable path. The approved topology is codec depends on view; no other dependency, module, vocabulary, source, candidate, or landing authority is implied.

Three required semantic repairs:
1. AdmittedViewBasis cannot be minted from arbitrary checksums and receipt-shaped ids. Separate untrusted wire claims from admitted values. Admission must consume and match the actual acquisition/build/adjudication/fixture authority and build receipt, including source and build identities. Mutants: wrong build checksum, wrong authority receipt, and fixture relabel under the same source checksum all refuse.
2. Profile satisfaction cannot be fabricated by a public Passed label or arbitrary nonempty court set. Produce an unforgeable verified receipt only from the exact required court plan and evidence; wire input remains an untrusted claim until revalidated. Mutant: one arbitrary passed court never satisfies the profile.
3. ReportReceipt cannot be decorative. Derive and bind a complete deterministic report input plus configuration identity to this result, and reject a receipt from another result even when role and media type match. Mutant: exact cross-result foreign-input receipt refuses.

The Scala construction courts must close apply, copy, companion fromProduct, and Mirror.ProductOf from outside the defining packages, with same-shape positive controls, but those static doors are not sufficient: executable courts must kill removal of every joined-claim check above.

Author gate in a standalone clone: git diff --check; exact 11-path check; scalafmtCheckAll last; acquire, view, and codec tests on JVM, JS, and Native; no new warning; outside-package construction probes; each named semantic mutation demonstrably fails. Record exact totals, command exits, SHA, parent, path set, and frozen-source hashes. Request independent scala-type/provenance review from codex-storymodel-collab after immutable candidate proposal. Do not authorize, land, or close S1-S4 child beads.
